rows.question: Who do I call if my work laptop is stolen, and how quickly?
rows.answer: A lost or stolen device must be reported to the security desk at extension 4410 within two hours of discovery [1].

rows.question: How much paid leave does the secondary carer of a new baby get?
rows.answer: The primary carer of a new child receives 22 weeks of fully paid parental leave [1]. The secondary carer receives 8 weeks of fully paid leave, which may be taken in up to two blocks during the first year [1].

rows.question: Can I return a purifier cartridge after opening it?
rows.answer: If the flow drops below 0.5 litres per minute even after backflushing, replace the cartridge [2]. Products with printed logos cannot be returned [3].

rows.question: What is the fee for repairing a tent that is out of warranty?
rows.answer: Outside the warranty, we repair tents and backpacks for a flat fee of 35 euros, including return postage [1]. Tents and backpacks carry a five-year warranty [1].

rows.question: How often should the cartridge be backflushed?
rows.answer: If the flow drops below 0.5 litres per minute even after backflushing, replace the cartridge [1]. Backflush the cartridge after every 50 litres by pumping clean water through it in reverse [1].
cited: rill_purifier_manual.md, section: Larkspur Rill Water Purifier Manual > Cleaning and storage

rows.question: What does the Rill not filter out?
rows.answer: The Rill removes bacteria, protozoa and microplastics [1]. The Rill is a hand-pumped water purifier for hikers [2].
cited: rill_purifier_manual.md, section: Larkspur Rill Water Purifier Manual > What it removes

rows.question: When do carried-over holidays expire?
rows.answer: Up to 6 unused days may be carried into the next year, but carried days expire on 31 March [1].

rows.question: How big is the learning budget?
rows.answer: Every employee has a learning budget of 1,200 euros per calendar year for courses, books and conferences, plus four paid learning days [1]. Courses costing more than 800 euros require a short written proposal to the line manager [1].

rows.question: My Rill cartridge froze on a trip. Is it safe to keep using, and will the warranty pay for a new one?
rows.answer: If the flow drops below 0.5 litres per minute even after backflushing, replace the cartridge [3]. Before storing the Rill for more than two weeks, soak the cartridge for 10 minutes in a mild bleach solution of 2 ml per litre, then let it dry completely for 48 hours [3].
cited: rill_purifier_manual.md, section: Larkspur Rill Water Purifier Manual > Cleaning and storage

rows.question: An employee has worked here for six years. How many annual leave days do they get in total?
rows.answer: Full-time employees receive 26 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays [1].

rows.question: What do standard and express delivery each cost?
rows.answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days and costs 4.90 euros [1]. Express delivery takes one working day, costs 12.50 euros, and is available only for orders placed before 13:00 [1].
